accessibility.keyboardScope: W/L/U and arrows apply only on adventure with focus inside .game-window, no open terminal, no Alt/Ctrl/Meta, and no form/details target. Native dialog Escape closes the terminal.
accessibility.dialogFocus: Opening focuses Close; closing restores the initiating element.
accessibility.reducedMotion: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce removes every animation/transition and sets scroll-behavior:auto; position changes become instant.
accessibility.feedback: Interaction-only speech, terminal feedback, storage failures and toasts use live status semantics. Hover sentences are not live announcements.
accessibility.touch: Phone hotspots and all verbs have minimum44px dimensions; nine verbs remain beside inventory on phones.

provenance.status: Owner-approved room and character are preserved; owner-requested minimal classic adventure UI replaces repeated coaching.
provenance.tonalRamps: Synthesized OKLCH lightness previews only; not production color scales.
provenance.previewLimits: Five static HTML/CSS snippets; runtime is in src/main.ts. Fonts are self-hosted by the app; isolated previews may use declared fallbacks.
provenance.toolingLimits: No Impeccable launcher, comp-spec, or comp-diff score; no separate approved page comp or formal certification claimed.
provenance.review: Desktop/mobile renders and font-loading checks verify the owner-supplied Day Of The Tentacle font; approved artwork and game layout are preserved.
provenance.verification: Production build, desktop/mobile layout checks, and browser font-loading/spacing checks at320,390,601,768 and1440px pass.

shapeDetails.gameFrame: Square borderless frame, flat deep plum control field.

character.status: Owner-approved photo-guided directional sprites; change only display scale for this refinement.
character.observedLayout: 30% scene width; 54% scene height; contain and bottom aligned. 50% larger; same artwork, aspect ratio, and floor anchor.
character.directionRule: Separate drawings preserve anatomical left-arm sleeve; no CSS mirroring.
character.privacy: Keep raw reference photographs and private share URLs out of published assets and public repository.
character.referenceEvidence: Four unique uploaded photographs have been inspected: face portrait, front full body, side full body/anatomical left sleeve, and chest tattoo. Raw photographs remain outside the checkout and published site.
character.observedAppearance: Higher hairline; short swept brown hair; broad brown tortoiseshell frames; full tapered mostly-brown beard with very little grey; slim fit build; sage V-neck; blue-grey trousers; bold plum contours, enlarged head, compact body, and oversized off-white shoes. Anatomical LEFT sleeve remains on its correct arm; only tiger foreleg/paw and clouds show at the neckline.
character.roomPreservation: The owner-loved room artwork remains byte-for-byte unchanged.
character.externalLinkHistory: External LinkedIn/iCloud access remains affected by the workspace proxy. Inspected local uploads now supply the needed references, so the historical external-link failure no longer blocks drawing.
character.futureCorrections: Preserve approved artwork and enlarged display scale unless the owner requests a further change.

interactionModel.command: Empty on arrival; hover or focus builds the action sentence. Always reserves one line plus 10px padding, including when empty, so verbs remain stationary; long text ellipsizes.
interactionModel.speech: Interaction-only text over the room. Inspecting research papers reveals a 44px-high gold PDF link below the response; only that link receives pointer events, it opens in a new tab, and the next response hides it.
interactionModel.reflection: Removed; no placeholder prose. Real reflections may be added when the owner supplies them.
interactionModel.layout: Game and scene label centred at maximum 1000px, filling narrower containers.

narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: The room leads.**

An original chunky, slightly goofy **Day of the Tentacle-inspired** cartoon world: leaning lilac architecture, bold outlines and exaggerated proportions. McGill's orange floorboards extend into Nortel's crooked raised-floor tiles, teal OME racks and looping yellow fibre. The owner-approved McGill room is the style authority for the original Nortel artwork and its transparent scene props. Preserve both room backgrounds and both approved photo-guided idle sprites. Separate directional walk cycles carry the same identity, sage outfit, tortoiseshell glasses and anatomical left-arm sleeve without mirroring. Character display remains 30% of scene width and 54% of scene height, with feet anchored to the floor in both rooms.

The owner explicitly wants less exposition and accepts that some visitors may not figure out the game. The wordmark, navigation and short-version link remain. Each scene has one understated label: **McGill University, 2006** or **Nortel**. No Nortel year has been supplied. There is no marketing headline, scene slogan, opening instruction, objective checklist, hint, walkthrough, duplicate object list, or initial dialogue. The reflection sidebar and placeholder text are removed; the game is centred.
keyCharacteristics: Owner-approved McGill room and enlarged idle character; original Nortel and directional walk-cycle extensions.
Understated scene labels; only McGill has a supplied year.
Flat classic nine-verb grid and pictorial inventory.
Exploration without coaching; direct short-version access.
Centred game with no sidebar or placeholder prose.
dos: Preserve the wordmark, approved idle artwork and enlarged character scale; keep separate directional walk drawings anatomically consistent.
Keep keyboard focus, labelled hotspots and reduced motion.
Keep direct short-version navigation and quiet scene framing.
donts: Do not add onboarding or objectives back into the game.
Do not publish private photos or share URLs.
Do not invent biographical claims or imply planned rooms are playable.
